design_request: 研究者重建任务：两人居住的6米×5米房间已有固定厨卫设施。保留房壳、开口、操作台及其上的灶台和水槽、三件卫浴设施，使用所给目录完成床、沙发、桌子、两把椅子、小冰箱和三件柜体的家具布置。需要睡眠、起居、两人吃饭、厨房与卫生间接近、窗前接近和可取放收纳，并尽量保有连续起居空间。不得删掉必需角色或缩放资产；未测功能请保留未知。这里的尺寸、人数、设施与目录均为研究者设定，不是住户原始任务或原项目精确平面。
unknowns: 6x5x2.6m shell, northwest bathroom, one window and initial furniture placements are researcher assumptions, not the source surveyed plan or historical before-state.
Source describes an integrated built-in technical/storage wall. Three separate .8x.4x2.2m movable proxy cabinets express only peripheral concentration of external envelopes.
Original four-window lighting, construction/services integration, storage capacity, door opening, material/design quality and physical handling are unverified.
Bed/kitchen/bathroom/chairs/lighting are declared proxies; sofa/table are fixed cached mesh substitutes. Same generic structural template as AIR is shared, never an independent test split.
2cm grid, square bodies .4/.5/.6m at1.8m height and fully open proxy door leaves are conditional geometric scenarios, not comfort or accessibility standards.
V2 repairs researcher-invented input geometry; protected living/dining points follow the newly declared object positions. It is not a method comparison with v1 or another independent project.
Six installed kitchen/bath fixture proxies are supplied, not produced by this construction episode. Raised cooker and sink cannot be added with the floor-only tool.
Nine movable furniture instances will be newly created; no original/historical identity-preservation claim.
Seven of the nine templates are procedural envelope proxies; sofa/table are cached mesh substitutes. Derived GLBs do not turn proxies into measured real furniture.
New task authored after prior storage replay; not an independent or sealed evaluation.
Only source-supported peripheral storage subdecision receives professional attribution; other additions are action-only reconstruction.
Training requires separate review; data preparation is not training authorization.
